neighbours.label: the possessive or article right after a quoted maxim or saying ('<saying> is my|', 'has become a|'), where 'motto/mantra/slogan' is the expected next word
fire: Live simply and give freely is my rule for every season.
Measure twice, cut once has become a guide for our whole shop.
Leave no one behind was his promise to the team.
Always be kind, even when it costs you, is my guiding thought.
Better late than never has become a joke in our family.
Say less and listen more is my answer to every argument.
Slow and steady wins the race was her favourite line as a coach.
Fortune favours the bold has become a creed for the new founders.
quiet: My older brother is my rule for every season, he joked.
The old workbench has become a guide for our whole shop.
Carrying the heavy radio was his promise to the team.
That small blue notebook is my guiding thought, she said.
The broken garden gnome has become a joke in our family.
This tired old couch is my answer to every argument.
The hallway near the gym was her favourite spot as a coach.
The cramped garage has become a creed for the new founders.

predictions: determiner after a stated maxim 0.4-0.6 whatever word follows; 'is my' after an ordinary subject below 0.15
notes: Card: peaks on ' his', ' my', ' a', ' the old', 'el' right before motto/mantra/aphorism/eslogan; logits suppress ' mantra' / ' maxim' (signed). Probe: 'Work hard and stay humble is my motto' 0.488 and 'is my advice' 0.488 (peak ' my', next word irrelevant); 'has become a mantra' 0.458 = 'a habit' 0.458; 'the old saying' 0.185; 'The motto of the school' 0.043; 'Their slogan is printed' 0.023. Near misses remove the maxim, not just the noun.
